stemMarkdown: Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?

options.markdown: Not only did she finish the report, but she also presented it.
Not only she finished the report, but she also presented it.
Not only did she finish the report, but she presented it also.
Not only she did finish the report, but also presented it.

solutionMarkdown: **Not only** at the start of a clause forces inversion — **did she finish** — and it pairs with **but also** in the standard correlative structure.
